**Gröbner-Shirshov bases and PBW theorems**

*School of Mathematical Sciences, South China Normal University*

13 pp, 18 sections.

**Abstract.** We review some applications of Gr¨obner-Shirshov bases, including PBW the- orems, linear bases of free universal algebras, normal forms for groups and semigroups, extensions of groups and algebras, embedding of algebras.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Gröbner-Shirshov bases for associative algeb; 2.1 Composition-Diamond lemma for associative ; 2.2 Composition-Diamond lemma for Lie algebras; 3 PBW theorems; 3.1 Lie algebras–associative algebras (Shirsho; 3.2 Lie algebras–pre-Lie algebras (Segal); 3.3 Leibniz algebras–dialgebras (Aymon, Grivel; 3.4 Akivis algebras–non-associative algebras (; 3.5 Sabinin algebras–modules (Perez-Izquierdo); 3.6 Dendriform algebras–Rota-Baxter algebras (; 3.7 Shirshov's, Cartier's, Cohn's counter exam; 3.8 ``1/2 PBW theorem" (Bokut-Fong-Ke); 4 Linear bases of free universal algebras; 5 Normal forms for groups and semigroups; 6 Schreier extensions of groups and algebras; 7 Embedding of algebras
